raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely equated the Wikipedia phrasing “supervisor of the royal works” with the formal office “Surintendant des Bâtiments du Roi” under Henry III without evidence. A scholarly source (Persée) later explicitly identified Jean Baptiste Androuet du Cerceau as “architecte de la cour de Henri III” (court architect), not Surintendant. This misinterpretation set the investigation on the wrong title.
